# Hostile cases and countermodels

- A zero-image-only formula fails at the cut locus because two geodesics have
  equal length there. The paper uses an antipodal pair.
- A pointwise positive heat kernel does not license log differentiation of a
  truncated enclosure. The paper proves the quantitative floor `1-Q0`.
- Sampled derivative values do not imply an interval supremum. Bounds are
  obtained from analytic majorants before evaluation.
- A standalone heat-kernel tail is not an interacting plaquette marginal.
  The lattice corollary is deterministic and local only.
- A theorem for each finite `M` is not uniform in `M` at fixed `t0`; the
  time/order condition is retained explicitly.
- Binary floating-point agreement between formulas is diagnostic, not proof.
